title: Route guard-dependent and/or conditions to the short-circuit article
summary: The AL performance review skill gains a targeted cue to worklist the boolean-operators-do-not-short-circuit article when an and/or condition joins a guard with an operand that depends on it, such as a division, subscript or field read after Get. The article is also added to the performance override in the review fixtures.
key_points: Adds a cue in al-performance-review.md for guard-dependent and/or conditions
Conditions whose operands are all independently safe and cheap are excluded
Review fixtures now use the article's bad and good examples as positive and clean cases
Demo runs found the issue in 2 of 2 runs versus 0 of 2 before
Fixture, contract and frontmatter validators pass
